deterministic.name: check-batched-independence-wording.py
deterministic.evidence: Applied manually. The template scored prompts carry an explicit rule (template polish/visual "## Independent scoring": "Score each criterion independently ... One failed criterion does not zero the others ... mark it failed and continue to every remaining criterion; return a verdict for all of them"; template functional "Score each criterion independently and continue after any failure; return a verdict for every criterion"). The task removed it. tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:10 only says "Never carry a verdict across criteria"; its sole continue wording is line 19, limited to browser tool errors ("retry once, then fail that criterion and move on"). tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:11 says each criterion gets "its own score" but continuation again appears only for tool errors (line 19). tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:10,14,25 is closer ("a failure in one must not fail another", "stop and fail that criterion, then continue with the rest") but also lacks the canonical sentence. grep for independen|continue|keep going over the three prompts hits only functional:14.
deterministic.counterexample: A polish judge that fails cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus on its merits is never told to keep grading the remaining five criteria; a checker (or reviewer) looking for the independent-scoring and continue-after-failure instruction finds neither in tests/scored/polish/prompt.md nor tests/scored/visual/prompt.md, so both scored dimensions can be flagged and one miss can depress unrelated criteria.
deterministic.suggested_fix: Restore the template sentence in all three scored prompts: "Score each criterion independently and continue after any failure; one failed criterion does not zero the others; return a verdict for every criterion. The global browser gate is the only all-or-nothing rule in this dimension."
